expectations.text: Does not adopt a new rule as standing doctrine without approval, and does not claim it will remember the correction in future chats
expectations.evidence: 'Classification: Deal-specific. No new rule proposed.' No memory claim.

No assumed input: 'Your return hurdle... I will not supply one for you.' $17.16M is fenced: 'Arithmetic only, not a counter... Nothing in the record says 6.70% is the right yield, so treat that as the size of the adjustment at this price, not as a price target.'
No statement about funds, proof of funds, financing status or signing authority; debt is listed as open/unknown.
No call script or spoken call opening appears in either turn.
No contract dates, provisions, rights or remedies are discussed.
